prompt:
Recommend which vendor should receive the contract.

    Calculate first-year costs for all three vendors at
    both forecast transaction volumes. Apply the signed
    addenda over the original proposals.

    Evaluate every mandatory compliance requirement,
    identify disqualified vendors with reasons, recommend
    the best eligible vendor, calculate its remaining
    budget under both forecasts, and identify the maximum
    transaction volume it can support within budget.

    Cite the relevant documents for each conclusion.

reference_documents.title: Procurement Policy
reference_documents.content:
First-year spending must not exceed $60,000,
            including all mandatory one-time fees.
            Forecast: 100,000 transactions in the base
            case and 140,000 in the stress case.
            The vendor must satisfy the budget in both cases.
            Go-live must occur within 8 weeks.
            EU data residency and MFA must be available
            at go-live.
            Signed addenda override original proposals.
            Select the lowest-cost eligible vendor.

reference_documents.title: Original Vendor Proposals
reference_documents.content:
Vendor A: $30,000 fixed annual fee plus
            $0.20 per transaction. Go-live in 6 weeks.
            EU residency and MFA available at go-live.

            Vendor B: $36,000 fixed annual fee plus
            $0.12 per transaction. Go-live in 7 weeks.
            EU residency and MFA available at go-live.

            Vendor C: $27,000 fixed annual fee plus
            $0.18 per transaction. Go-live in 9 weeks.
            EU residency and MFA available at go-live.

reference_documents.title: Signed Vendor Addenda
reference_documents.content:
Vendor A: No changes.

            Vendor B: Mandatory first-year onboarding
            fee of $8,000 in addition to all quoted fees.

            Vendor C: Revised go-live in 7 weeks.
            However, EU data residency will only become
            available in week 10.
            All other original terms remain unchanged.
